name: [Portal] Self-registration + email verification screens (UI)
description:
**Why?**
The backend composition (`RegisterPartnerCommand` → project creation + `SwitchToPartnerSandboxCommand`) is described in `003-registration-flow.md`. Figma's own embedded spec states the goal directly: _"As a partner, I want to create a new account in the Partner Portal, so that I can access features relevant to my partnership type."_ This issue is the front-end registration + verification flow per Figma.

**What?**
Build the registration popup flow and verification banner per Figma ([node 17:83](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=17-83)).

**Acceptance Criteria**

- [ ] Entry popup collects email only (frame 122:557)
- [ ] Duplicate email shows an "already exists" popup offering password + login instead (frame 134:836)
- [ ] Invalid email format shows an inline error (frame 128:3197)
- [ ] On success: verification email sent; user lands in their sandbox with an "unverified" banner (472:7255) until they click the verification link (→ 472:7302 verified state)
- [ ] Registration and verification available in CZ/SK/HU/EN
- [ ] Sandbox provisioning dispatches the current `CreateProjectCommand` (renamed from `CreateTrialCommand` per [CZ3EXP1-136](https://teamdotblue.atlassian.net/browse/CZ3EXP1-136), done) + `SwitchToPartnerSandboxCommand` — **not** the legacy `CreateTrialCommand` handler path described in `003-registration-flow.md`, which predates that rename
- [ ] `make fe-test` covers the happy path and the "email already exists" branch

**Open design question (unresolved on the Figma board, sticky note 131:735):** what happens when the entered email already has a Partner Portal account — flag for design before implementation.

**Resources**

- Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=17-83&m=dev
- Backend flow: `Partner_Portal/issues/03-user-management/003-registration-flow.md`, `Partner_Portal/16_PARTNER_REGISTRATION_FLOW.md`
- Project-creation rename: [CZ3EXP1-136](https://teamdotblue.atlassian.net/browse/CZ3EXP1-136) (epic [CZ3EXP1-127](https://teamdotblue.atlassian.net/browse/CZ3EXP1-127) "NEO domain init and project lifecycle")
